definitions.explanation: The arrangement of lights to illuminate a space, or the lights themselves.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{照明|しょうめい}を{明|あか}るくした。
examples.english: I made the room lighting brighter.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}{照明|しょうめい}が{美|うつく}しい。
LED{照明|しょうめい}に{切|き}り{替|か}えると{電気代|でんきだい}が{安|やす}くなる。
examples.english: Switching to LED lighting will lower your electricity bill.

notes:
{照明|しょうめい} refers to lighting systems and light fixtures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {照明|しょうめい}{器具|きぐ} (lighting fixture)
- {舞台|ぶたい}{照明|しょうめい} (stage lighting)
- {間接|かんせつ}{照明|しょうめい} (indirect lighting)
- {照明|しょうめい}を{落|お}とす (to dim the lights)
- {照明|しょうめい}を{つける|つける} (to turn on the lights)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
{照明|しょうめい} (lighting) vs {証明|しょうめい} (proof) - same reading, different meaning and kanji.
